display.name: 2. On whose behalf, and was it allowed?

spec.text: Identity is on every span: `enduser.id` (the principal), `gen_ai.agent.name`, `agent_obs.role` from baggage, and on the gateway `litellm.metadata.user_api_key_alias` (the agent's own key), `litellm.team.alias`, `litellm.end_user.id`. Every control records its decision where it was made: `authz.decision` on tool spans, HTTP status on gateway spans, `litellm.guardrail.status` on guardrail spans, `triage.denied_by` on the agent span that was refused.

display.name: Model calls, and distinct principals they were made for

spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, count() AS calls, uniq(SpanAttributes['litellm.end_user.id']) AS principals, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.end_user.id']='') AS calls_without_principal FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName='litellm-gateway' AND SpanName LIKE 'chat%' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

display.name: Model calls per key alias (which agent, as the gateway verified it)

spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.metadata.user_api_key_alias']='agent-retriever') AS retriever, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.metadata.user_api_key_alias']='agent-analyser') AS analyser, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.metadata.user_api_key_alias']='agent-reporter') AS reporter, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.metadata.user_api_key_alias'] IN ('agent-restricted','agent-throttled')) AS demo_keys, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.metadata.user_api_key_alias']='') AS master_key FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName='litellm-gateway' AND SpanName LIKE 'chat%' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, countIf(SpanAttributes['authz.decision']='allow') AS allow, countIf(SpanAttributes['authz.decision']='deny') AS deny FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanAttributes['authz.decision']!='' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

display.name: Gateway refusals by kind (from the agent spans' triage.denied_by)

spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, countIf(SpanAttributes['triage.denied_by']='gateway:model_access') AS model_access, countIf(SpanAttributes['triage.denied_by']='gateway:rate_limit') AS rate_limit, countIf(SpanAttributes['triage.denied_by']='gateway:guardrail') AS guardrail FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanAttributes['triage.denied_by']!='' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.guardrail.status']='success') AS allowed, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.guardrail.status']='guardrail_intervened') AS intervened FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanAttributes['litellm.guardrail.name']!='' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, countIf(StatusCode='Error') AS error_spans FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName='litellm-gateway' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

display.name: Data access by resource (agent_obs.access.resource on tool spans)

spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, countIf(SpanAttributes['agent_obs.access.resource'] LIKE 'prometheus:%') AS prometheus, countIf(SpanAttributes['agent_obs.access.resource'] LIKE 'git:%') AS git, countIf(SpanAttributes['agent_obs.access.resource'] LIKE 'runbook%') AS runbooks, countIf(SpanAttributes['agent_obs.access.resource'] LIKE 'k8s:%') AS kubernetes FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanAttributes['agent_obs.access.resource']!='' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
